text.tspan: One adapter turns omnigent's StreamHooks into MLflow spans.
Pluggable executors the runtime dispatches to.
nested under one trace per turn.
1. Caller sends a prompt through the SDK, CLI, or web UI.
2. Runner dispatches the chosen executor, which talks to the LLM provider.
3. Adapter opens and closes one MLflow span per StreamHooks callback.
4. The whole turn surfaces as ONE MLflow trace with the full span tree.
